motion.name: fluid-ease
motion.purpose: Fluid, rhythmic transitions for the Midnight Engine.

components.name: Neon Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-neon { background: #fafafa; color: #18181b; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; border: none; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-neon:hover { background: #f4f4f5; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2); }

components.name: Glass Container
components.description: The atmospheric surface for tools and stats.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(9, 9, 11, 0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; color: #fafafa; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: The Deep Sea Instrument / Midnight Engine
narrative.overview: FokusMode is a high-performance productivity instrument. It rejects static environments for an immersive Midnight Engine where design recedes.
dos: Do use pulse-glow for active states
